title: 'RHOSLC's Angie Katsanevas on '180' in Her Friendship With Mary Cosby
summary: 'Real Housewives of Salt Lake City's Angie Katsanevas details the strain that Mary Cosby's recent public comments about her have put on their friendship.
body_markdown:
Angie Katsanevas doesn’t know where she stands with[Real Housewives of Salt Lake City](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/real-housewives) castmate Mary Cosby.


In an interview on[Radio Andy’s The Julia Cunningham Show](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/julia-cunningham) , the reality TV star reacted to Mary’s claims from a recent episode of *Watch What Happens Live* , in which she attempted to sit her on husband Robert Cosby Sr.’s lap – following their son Robert Cosby Jr.’s funeral. Listen to the full episode on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAngieKatsanevasJuliaCunninghamShow) .


[The Julia Cunningham Show Pop culture, reality TV & entertainment Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAngieKatsanevasJuliaCunninghamShow)


“I guess I was a little rattled and hurt by some of her comments last night on *Watch What Happens Live* and some of her comments on Anderson Cooper,” Angie told Julia. “And the way that she’s recalling things and the things that she’s saying.”


On the November 18 episode of *Real Housewives of Salt Lake City* , Mary and Angie appeared to repair their friendship, following an explosive fight at the reiki lunch. However, a year after filming, Angie shared that Mary is no longer in contact with her.


“After watching last night,” Angie said. “I was like, ‘How did we go from that to here?’”


Angie revealed that as recently as a month ago, she and Mary briefly communicated after she sent a text telling her, “I love her and I miss her.” Though Mary replied at the time, Angie has been shut out again.


“I feel like it’s a 180 from us really getting to a better place,” she told Julia. “Obviously, with moments of hurt because Mary is grieving. I tried to understand that along the way that every day wasn’t going to be a great day. After the reiki lunch, I would follow her lead, ‘Does she want to hear from me? Does she not?’ Sending her flowers, sending her cards, checking in. Without being annoying.”


As for filming the upcoming reunion with Mary? Angie isn’t sure how it’s going to go.


“I thought it was going to look one way,” she said. “But waking up this morning maybe it’s going to look a different way.”


Angie added that there’s only so many times she can extend and olive branch Mary’s way.


“I’m willing to continue to try,” she said. “But if the door keeps getting closed in my face, I have to read the room.”
